# fjordrun_templates (Data Source)

The template catalog, for `fjordrun_template_deployment`. Needs no token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_templates" "all" {}

output "codes" {
  value = data.fjordrun_templates.all.templates[*].code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
